info.title: Wayselect preview server
info.description: Machine-readable route table for web/server.js (TOG-6040, gap G3 from TOG-6013). Fixture-only preview server: stub data, no backend writes, ever. Every response carries X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer; HTML responses additionally carry X-Frame-Options: DENY plus a per-response nonce CSP. JSON error statuses (>= 400) carry Cache-Control: no-store and the triage envelope (see x-error-envelope): an x-request-id response header echoed as requestId in the body. Success JSON carries no id. Fixture-deterministic success JSON (GET /healthz, flag-on index JSON, detail fragment) is cacheable (TOG-6050): ETag + Cache-Control: public, max-age=60 with 304 on matching If-None-Match (see x-cacheable). Rate limiting (120 req/60s per IP+route bucket) applies to every route except GET /healthz and /favicon.ico, which answer before the limiter; over-limit answers are 429 { error: rate_limited, retryAfterSec, requestId } with a Retry-After header. Gated routes return 404 when WAYSELECT_PREVIEW is off (see each operation). Unknown paths fall through to the fallback contract (see x-fallback below): JSON { error: not_found, requestId } by default, HTML only for explicit browser navigation (Accept: text/html without application/json).
info.x-flag: WAYSELECT_PREVIEW (truthy: 1/true/yes/on case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed; absent or any other value means off)

servers.description: Local preview server (HOST/PORT env override the host and port)

/healthz.summary: Liveness probe (TOG-5726): ungated by WAYSELECT_PREVIEW, exempt from rate limiting

get.summary: Liveness probe; query strings are ignored, trailing slash (/healthz/) is NOT this route (falls to x-fallback 404)

200.description: Server is alive. Cacheable (TOG-6050): ETag + Cache-Control: public, max-age=60

304.description: Matching If-None-Match (TOG-6050): empty body, validators repeated

405.description: Any non-GET method on this path; Allow: GET (RFC 9110 15.5.6)

/favicon.ico.summary: 204 No Content icon sink (TOG-6369): ungated, exempt from rate limiting

get.summary: Answers 204 so page loads stop emitting 404 log noise; there is no icon asset

405.description: Any non-GET method on this path; Allow: GET

/listings.summary: Stub listing index, flag-gated (trailing slash /listings/ is the same route; flag-on serves identical bodies with a slashless canonical link; flag-on honors Accept: application/json, flag-off stays HTML-only)

get.summary: HTML index of stub listings with search/filter/sort/paging by default; JSON paged result / invalid-filter error when Accept negotiates application/json (TOG-7661); Vary: Accept on every flag-on variant; GET only

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text query over name, route id and provider name; at most 200 chars, over-long fails closed 400

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size 1-100, default 20; malformed or out-of-range fails closed 400

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page offset >= 0, default 0; malformed fails closed 400 (offset past the end is an empty 200 page, never 400)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Explicit result ordering (TOG-6362, gap G1); default keeps the historical stub order; unknown values fail closed 400 like every other filter

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: application/json selects the JSON result / error shapes (flag-on only); otherwise HTML

200.description: HTML listing index (paginated window with full match count), or the JSON paged result {listings, total, limit, offset} when Accept: application/json — including the empty state and offset-past-end (empty page, intact total). The documented ETag/Cache-Control headers ride the JSON variant only (TOG-6050: ETag + public, max-age=60); HTML carries no validators

304.description: Matching If-None-Match on the JSON variant (TOG-6050): empty body, validators repeated

400.description: Invalid filter query (unknown key, bad capability/modality/sort, over-long q, bad limit/offset): HTML invalid-filter page naming every problem, or JSON {error: invalid_filter, kind, value, valid, errors} plus the triage requestId when Accept: application/json

404.description: WAYSELECT_PREVIEW off: HTML preview-disabled page (the flag-off index stays HTML-only even under JSON negotiation — it has no fragment shape)

405.description: Any non-GET method (method gate precedes the flag gate, so flag-off still 405s); Allow: GET

/listings/{provider}/{model}.summary: Listing-detail shell (flag-gated); Accept: application/json returns the { html } content fragment

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider id; stub lookup is an exact (case-sensitive) match, so uppercase segments (TOG-6711) 404 as misses instead of remapping

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id; exact case-sensitive match, uppercase variants 404 as misses

get.summary: HTML shell by default; JSON fragment when Accept negotiates application/json; Vary: Accept on every variant

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: application/json selects the fragment / JSON error shapes; otherwise HTML

200.description: HTML detail shell, or the JSON content fragment when Accept: application/json (dev slow-network knob WAYSELECT_DETAIL_FRAGMENT_DELAY_MS delays the fragment only, never first paint). The documented ETag/Cache-Control headers ride the JSON fragment only (TOG-6050: ETag + public, max-age=60); HTML carries no validators

304.description: Matching If-None-Match on the JSON fragment (TOG-6050): empty body, validators repeated

404.description: Flag off (HTML preview-disabled, or JSON { error: preview_disabled, requestId } for fragment fetches); undecodable segments (HTML not-found); unknown listing incl. uppercase variants and case mismatches (HTML not-found, or JSON { error: listing_not_found, requestId } for fragment fetches)

405.description: Any non-GET method (method gate precedes the flag gate); Allow: GET

500.description: Render throw: HTML listing-detail error page (fragment path falls back to the same HTML 500; HTML carries no request id)

/listings/{provider}/{model}/purchase.summary: Stub CTA target (TOG-5710): never writes, always refuses; NOT flag-gated (refuses with the flag off too); honors the optional Idempotency-Key header (TOG-6030)

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider id; exact case-sensitive match, uppercase variants 404 as unknown listings

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional opaque client token (UUID recommended, at most 256 chars). Same key + same purchase replays the stored 403 refusal with the key echoed and replayed:true (no duplicate effect); same key + different route is 422 idempotency_key_reused (mint a fresh key); blank keys are 400 invalid_idempotency_key (missing-field) and overlong keys are 400 invalid_idempotency_key (invalid-value). Validation runs after the 404/405 gates, so a key never masks a routing verdict.

post.summary: 404 for unknown listings (nonexistent resource 404s first), 403 preview_only for real listings (with idempotencyKey echo, replayed:true on replay); 400 invalid_idempotency_key for blank/overlong keys; 422 idempotency_key_reused when the key was already used for a different purchase; trailing slash is the same route; always JSON

403.description: Known listing: purchases disabled in preview, no backend writes; first effect echoes the sent Idempotency-Key as idempotencyKey, a replay adds replayed:true — plus the triage requestId

400.description: Blank Idempotency-Key (code missing-field) or overlong key (>256 chars, code invalid-value): invalid_idempotency_key with the validator vocab (key idempotencyKey)

422.description: Idempotency-Key already used for a different purchase attempt: mint a fresh key for a different attempt

404.description: Unknown listing or undecodable segments: { error: listing_not_found, requestId }

/listings/{provider}/{model}/disputes.summary: Buyer trust-signal dispute stub (TOG-8061): JSON-only stub reports, in-memory per listing (restart clears, ids restart at dispute-1); flag-gated; filing never charges or refunds (D10)

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider id; exact case-sensitive match, uppercase variants 404 as unknown listings

get.summary: Lists the filed stub reports for one real stub listing; always JSON

200.description: Dispute log: { listing, disputes: [] } fresh, or the filed reports after POSTs (success JSON carries no request id)

404.description: Flag off ({ error: preview_disabled, requestId }); undecodable segments or unknown listing ({ error: not_found, requestId })

405.description: Any method other than GET/POST; Allow: GET, POST

post.summary: Files one stub report after the strict JSON body gate ({buyer 1-120 chars, reason enum}, exact keys); always JSON

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Must be application/json; anything else is 400 invalid_dispute

requestBody.description: Dispute envelope (exact keys buyer + reason only); body capped at 64KB with a 10s total read deadline

201.description: Filed report: { id: dispute-N, listing, buyer, reason, status: open } (success JSON carries no request id)

400.description: Body gate or validator rejection: { error: invalid_dispute, message, validReasons } plus the triage requestId

404.description: Flag off ({ error: preview_disabled, requestId }); undecodable segments or unknown listing ({ error: not_found, requestId })

405.description: Any method other than GET/POST; Allow: GET, POST

408.description: Body read deadline exceeded: { error: invalid_dispute, message, validReasons }

413.description: Body over 64KB: { error: invalid_dispute, message, validReasons }

/sellers/submissions.summary: Seller intake (TOG-4969): strict JSON body gate, then fail-closed seller validator; flag-gated; trailing slash is the same route; Vary: Accept

post.summary: Validates the JSON body, records a pending intent in-memory (restart clears, 15-min TTL), returns the confirm model as JSON (or the HTML confirm screen for Accept: text/html)

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Must be application/json; anything else is 400 wrong_content_type

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: text/html selects the HTML confirm / rejection page; otherwise JSON

requestBody.description: Seller submission envelope (exact keys; executable location fields url/endpoint/baseUrl/apiUrl forbidden at any depth); body capped at 64KB with a 10s total read deadline

200.description: Valid submission: confirm model JSON plus confirmPath, or the HTML confirm screen for Accept: text/html (success JSON carries no request id)

400.description: Body gate (wrong_content_type, malformed_json) or validator rejection (invalid_submission with code/key/source); HTML rejection page for Accept: text/html

405.description: Any non-POST method (TOG-6707, via the shared helper); Allow: POST

408.description: Body did not complete within the 10s read bound (body_timeout envelope); client may retry

/sellers/submissions/{provider}/{model}/.summary: Seller confirm + receipt (TOG-4969): GET restates the pending intent, POST records it; neither publishes anything; Vary: Accept

get.summary: Restates the staged intent as JSON or HTML (Accept: text/html); 404 when no intent was staged, expired (>15 min), or never existed

200.description: Pending intent restated: confirm-model JSON, or the HTML confirm screen for Accept: text/html (success JSON carries no request id)

404.description: Flag off (HTML preview-disabled unless Accept: application/json, else JSON preview_disabled); undecodable segments (JSON not_found); no live intent (JSON no_pending_intent, or HTML intent-missing page for Accept: text/html)

post.summary: Records the staged intent, returns the listing-created receipt as JSON (or HTML for Accept: text/html); no live publish, ever

200.description: Receipt: { recorded: true, intentOnly: true, recordedAt, ...confirmModel }, or the HTML receipt for Accept: text/html (success JSON carries no request id)

404.description: Flag off (JSON preview_disabled); undecodable segments (JSON not_found); no live intent (JSON no_pending_intent)

405.description: Any method other than GET/POST answers 405 { error: method_not_allowed, requestId } via sendJson with NO Allow header (pinned quirk, TOG-6709)

x-fallback.description: Unknown paths and unparseable targets (TOG-5714): Vary: Accept; JSON { error: not_found, requestId } 404 by default (including */* fetch/curl defaults and missing Accept); HTML route-not-found page 404 only for explicit browser navigation (Accept: text/html without application/json). Unparseable request targets answer the same JSON 404. No Allow header on 404s (no resource, no Allow).

json.requestId: <32 lowercase hex, echoed from the x-request-id header>

x-error-envelope.description: Triage envelope on every JSON error (TOG-6717): the shared sendJsonError writer mints one crypto-random 128-bit id (32 lowercase hex) per error response, stamps it on the x-request-id response header, and echoes it as requestId in the body, so staging triage can match a response to logs. Two error responses carry distinct ids; header and body always agree. Covers sendJson error branches, the sendMethodNotAllowed 405 helper, the inline 429 refusal, and the direct seller-confirm 405. Success JSON (2xx) and HTML responses carry no id.

x-cross-cutting.methodNotAllowed: Known route shapes answer 405 { error: method_not_allowed, requestId } with an Allow header naming the supported methods (seller-confirm POST path excepted: no Allow header, pinned). Unknown paths stay 404 with no Allow.
x-cross-cutting.flagGating: GET /healthz, /favicon.ico and POST /listings/:provider/:model/purchase are ungated. GET /listings, GET /listings/:provider/:model, POST /sellers/submissions, both seller-confirm methods and both disputes methods 404 when WAYSELECT_PREVIEW is off (HTML page or JSON preview_disabled depending on Accept; see each operation).
x-cross-cutting.intentTtl: Staged seller intents expire 15 minutes after intake (SELLER_INTENT_TTL_MS); expired intents 404 as no_pending_intent and are dropped on read.
x-cross-cutting.caseSensitivity: Stub listing lookup is an exact case-sensitive match (TOG-6711): uppercase provider/model segments 404 as misses (HTML miss page by default, JSON listing_not_found on fragment negotiation) instead of remapping to the lowercase listing.
x-cross-cutting.x-cacheable: Cacheable success JSON (TOG-6050): GET /healthz, the flag-on index 200 JSON, and the detail 200 JSON fragment carry ETag (strong sha256 content hash of the exact response bytes) + Cache-Control: public, max-age=60. A matching If-None-Match (exact tag, *, or comma-list member; W/-prefixed weak tags compare by opaque value) answers 304 with an empty body and the validators repeated. HTML pages (per-response nonce CSP), error JSON (no-store), and seller-transactional JSON carry no validators.

RequestId.description: Per-error triage id (TOG-6717): 32 lowercase hex chars, crypto-random per response, echoed as requestId in the JSON error body

CacheableEtag.description: Strong content-hash validator (TOG-6050): sha256 of the exact JSON response bytes, base64url-encoded. Present on 200 and 304 alike; a matching If-None-Match (exact, *-wildcard, or comma-list member) earns a 304 with an empty body

CacheableCacheControl.description: Shared-cache window for fixture-deterministic JSON (TOG-6050): revalidate after 60s against the ETag. Error JSON instead carries no-store (TOG-6367)

version.description: SERVER_VERSION, read from package.json at module load (degrades to 'unknown')

html.description: Detail body fragment the shell's inline script fetches and renders

PurchaseRefusal.description: Preview purchase refusal. idempotencyKey echoes the sent Idempotency-Key header (first effect and replays); replayed:true marks replays.

message.example: Purchases are disabled in preview. No backend writes.

idempotencyKey.description: Echo of the request Idempotency-Key header; absent when no key was sent

replayed.description: True when this 403 replays a stored idempotency record (no new effect); absent on first effects

requestId.description: Triage id echoed from the x-request-id response header (TOG-6717)

IdempotencyKeyRejected.description: Overlong Idempotency-Key header (>256 chars): same invalid-value vocab as the purchase validator

IdempotencyKeyReused.description: Idempotency-Key already used for a different purchase attempt: mint a fresh key for a different attempt

IndexResult.description: Flag-on index JSON result (TOG-7661): the paginated window with the full match count; empty states return listings: [] (offset-past-end keeps the intact total). Success JSON carries no triage id.

listings.description: Paginated stub-listing window in sort order

total.description: Full match count across all pages

InvalidFilter.description: Flag-on index JSON invalid-filter error (TOG-7661): kind/value/valid mirror the first problem; errors lists every problem; requestId is the TOG-6717 triage id echoed from the x-request-id header

kind.description: First problem kind: capability, modality, sort, limit, offset, q, or query

value.description: Offending value (q and sort are truncated to 64 chars so the error stays bounded)

valid.description: Accepted values / bound for the first problem

BodyError.description: Strict JSON body-gate failure: error is wrong_content_type, body_too_large (413), malformed_json, or body_timeout (408)

DisputeBody.description: Stub dispute envelope (TOG-8061, spec shape §6): exact keys buyer + reason only; unknown fields 400

buyer.description: Trimmed 1-120 chars; accepted as data (evil input rides JSON-encoded, future HTML views must escape)

DisputeFiled.description: Filed stub report: deterministic id per listing per process (dispute-1, ...); status is always open (no triage in v1). Success JSON carries no triage id.

DisputeList.description: Per-listing dispute log (in-memory; restart clears). Success JSON carries no triage id.

InvalidDispute.description: Stub dispute rejection (TOG-8061, spec §5 D5/D7): error is always invalid_dispute; validReasons names the reason enum; requestId is the TOG-6717 triage id echoed from the x-request-id header

InvalidSubmission.description: Seller validator rejection: error is invalid_submission; code/key/source name the failure

modelId.description: Lowercase slug, at most 64 chars; must equal entry.id (SG2)

release_date.description: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, real calendar date

last_updated.description: YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, real calendar date

fetchedAt.description: ISO timestamp, must not be in the future (60s tolerance)

IntakeSuccess.description: Confirm model plus the follow-up path (success JSON carries no request id)

SellerReceipt.description: Listing-created receipt: confirm model plus recording facts; intent only, no publish (success JSON carries no request id)
